messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English with three adult friends together in an ordinary setting. Give all three distinct voices and reactions without labeling their personalities. Let the conversation overlap naturally, with shifting attention and small interruptions. Keep the group dynamic believable and grounded. Avoid making everyone equally witty or giving every line a punchline.

“That's not where that goes.”

Sam looked down at the box in his hands. “It's a box.”

“It's the wrong box,” Riley said.

Casey leaned around them to look. “How can there be a wrong box?”

“Because there are three sizes.”

Sam held up the one he'd picked. “This is medium.”

“That's large.”

He looked at the label. “It says large.”

Riley pointed at the shelf. “Exactly.”

Casey laughed. “I think we're overthinking storage.”

“We are not overthinking it,” Riley said. “We're trying to keep the kitchen from becoming a pile of random plastic.”

Sam looked toward the counter. “It already is.”

Casey followed his gaze.

“That's temporary.”

“How temporary?”

“Depends.”

“On what?”

“Whether anyone here cleans.”

Sam slowly turned toward Riley.

Riley shook her head. “Don't bring me into this.”

“You're the one organizing everybody.”

“I was organizing the cabinet.”

“Same thing.”

“No.”

Casey opened another drawer and frowned. “Why are there batteries in here?”

Sam shrugged. “They fit.”

Riley closed her eyes for a second.

“This is exactly what I'm talking about.”

“You don't like batteries?” Casey asked.

“I like batteries. I don't like finding batteries next to measuring spoons.”

“Useful combination,” Sam said.

Casey laughed again.

Riley gave them both a look, but she was smiling now.

“Fine. New plan. Nobody touches anything for five minutes.”

“That sounds less efficient,” Sam said.

“Five minutes,” she repeated.

Casey checked her phone. “I can do that.”

Sam set the box on the floor. “What are we waiting for?”

Riley pointed at him. “A miracle.”

He nodded seriously. “I'll put that on the list.”

Casey leaned against the counter. “Can the miracle also order pizza?”

Riley sighed.

“Now we're negotiating.”

Sam smiled. “Progress.”
